subject: Regional pay deltas and hiring queue prioritization
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Regional pay deltas for upcoming SDE hiring round

Stephanie / Monica —

We have three SDE offers queued for week of May 17 (1 US, 1 EU, 1 APAC). Before I push to offers, comp needs sign-off on regional deltas (COLA-style adjustments + benefit differentials). Rishi flagged that the EU hire might need a higher base than our published US-equivalent due to local market bands.

I pulled a quick model and attached a workbook (2027_Q2_geo_pay_delta_model.xlsx) with recommended multipliers and total OTEs under three scenarios (conservative / midpoint / aggressive). TL;DR: applying a simple COLA multiplier (+8% EU, +4% APAC) keeps us within target comp ratio and keeps hiring within budget under midpoint.

Asks:
- Can comp approve midpoint multipliers for these three roles so we can proceed this week?
- If approved, can Recruiting (Julia / HiringOps) start offer packaging with local benefits language and an estimated start-window?

I'm happy to jump on a quick 20m call if useful.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Software Eng (Platform)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2027_Q2_geo_pay_delta_model.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional pay deltas for upcoming SDE hiring round

Thanks Marcus — I reviewed the workbook. High-level thoughts:

- The midpoint multipliers look defensible but I want one tweak: bump EU to +10% for Berlin/Amsterdam markets (we've seen squeeze there).
- For APAC, separate out Australia (single-hire premium) vs SEA; model currently averages APAC and hides that spread.
- Please add the specific job-level comparators (Greenhouse req IDs) to the sheet so comp can match to published bands.

Monica / Rishi — can comp confirm whether +10% EU / +4% APAC (with Australia +12%) passes budget under committed Q2 headcount? If yes, I'll approve and ask Recruiting to proceed with offers this week.

If we need a faster decision, I'm available 2pm today for 20 minutes.

—Stephanie
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: HiringOps <hiringops@acme-talent.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia@globaltalent.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 08:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Regional pay deltas for upcoming SDE hiring round

Hi Stephanie / Marcus —

We can prep offer packs once you confirm the multipliers. A couple of operational notes from our side:
- Local benefits language differs: EU contracts must include statutory notice, pension contributions (we estimate ~6% employer contribution for DE/NL), and local leave entitlements.
- For APAC, tax withholding rules vary significantly; we'll include an estimated gross-to-net calculation for each city.

Julia (recruiter) has also uploaded one candidate pack for the APAC request (candidate_pack_JuliaPark.pdf) — see attached. If you approve the multipliers we will draft the letter templates and engagement emails.

Best,
HiringOps (on behalf of Julia Park)
Attachment: candidate_pack_JuliaPark.pdf (PDF, 450KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional pay deltas for upcoming SDE hiring round

Stephanie / team —

I reviewed Marcus's model and Stephanie's recommended tweaks. Given we have firm business need for the roles and the budget headroom from Q2, I'm comfortable approving the following for immediate offer issuance:

- EU hires (Berlin/Amsterdam): +10% base multiplier over US-equivalent band
- Other EU markets: +8% base multiplier
- APAC: +4% base multiplier; Australia exception +12%

Operational caveats: these multipliers apply to base salary only. Bonus/RSU targets remain aligned to role band. Recruiting must include local statutory benefits language and provide gross-to-net estimates where required.

Stephanie — please confirm and mark as approved so HiringOps can send offers.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: HiringOps <hiringops@acme-talent.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia@globaltalent.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional pay deltas for upcoming SDE hiring round

Approved and confirmed.

- Multipliers set: EU (Berlin/AMS) +10%, other EU +8%, APAC +4% (Australia +12%).
- Applies to base only; bonus/RSU unchanged.
- Recruiting: please use the attached template in Confluence (link below) and include local statutory callouts. Provide final offer letters to me for a quick pre-send review if the total cash exceeds +15% of the original band.

Tracking: I've updated the hiring queue and linked the comp workbook to HR-511 (see related links). Marcus — go ahead and push candidate approvals to Recruiting.

—Stephanie
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
